method: Graphical Editor, isolated save, real race and input. Split/RPM/proximity and career finishes are scripted boundary checks; no natural race completion claim.
passed: Real four-car race shows authoritative position, standings, persistent goal and distinct lap/race clocks from lap one
Minimap fits the live Racing Visuals circuit and includes all three real AI cars
Objective disappears after the intro; the unobstructed HUD remains live
Keyboard drives the RCCP car; displayed speed and gear come from its telemetry
Pause contains a readable goal and current progress recap
Escape pauses/resumes once; HUD is hidden behind pause and restored on resume
Virtual gamepad Start pauses/resumes and changes the pause prompt
Synthetic idle/limiter telemetry verifies twelve shift lamps without changing vehicle tuning
Scripted real-rival positions verify both proximity sides and reject cars on another elevation; no time gaps are fabricated
HUD remains in bounds and text fits at 115 percent with 95 percent safe area
Solo Time Attack explains its missing reference, keeps a persistent goal, and hides race-only information
RTG circuit map rebinds on scene change with its own geometry and no rivals in solo mode
Track limits show a temporary explanation and a persistent invalid-lap indicator
Synthetic checkpoint/lap events confirm a valid best lap and a measured split; invalid laps never replace the reference
Invalid lap suppresses its delta; HUD changes do not spend credits
Only/final invalid lap directs Retry after finish instead of promising a nonexistent next lap
Scripted invalid Shakedown result explains failure, focuses Retry and awards no medal or credits
Retry really reloads a clean session; scripted valid Shakedown saves Bronze and prioritizes Next Event
Next Event returns to its career briefing with progress retained
Career Time Attack retains the exact pass time in HUD and Pause
Synthetic result variants verify missed time, P4, free-session failure and reuse after failure without changing credits
